functions.notes: Shape and callees match (digit loop, 64-bit fixed-point table math, shadow sprite block, %10 via _s32_div_f). Remaining: callee-saved colouring. Target keeps n=r4,obj=r5,hi(-1)=r6,i=r7,slot=r8,baseX=sb,left=sl,digit=fp and spills the umull low word to [sp,#0x2c]; ours spills baseX to the stack and uses fp as the umull scratch (+1 instr). A diagnostic extra loop reference to baseX flipped it to baseX=sb and cut the diff from 112 to 38 lines, so the target reads the clamped x in the digit loop in a way that emits no code; no natural source form found. Not byte-exact. colorsweep --apply produced a semantically wrong rewrite (precedence change) and was reverted.
